messages:
erin: Heads-up: noticed some tenants getting charged against the wrong SKU this morning. embeddings calls counted as text tokens in the invoice preview for a ~30m window. ledger raw events show model_kind='embedding' but invoice pipeline grouped them under 'text'
chad: wow. any recent deploys that touch the metering schema?
maya: there was a small change in the proxy mapping that normalized model names to a canonical alias. looks like the proxy also dropped the 'metering_namespace' header for embedding routes during that deploy
kevin: aggregator currently uses (model_kind, model_alias) tuple to pick SKU. if metering_namespace is missing it falls back to a legacy classifier which maps embeddings->text unless explicit namespace present
erin: so missing header + classifier fallback -> wrong SKU. That explains the invoice preview mismatch vs raw ledger where raw events kept raw kind
lina: mitigation idea: add a light-weight detection in aggregator: if event has embedding signals (embedding_len != null) but model_kind != 'embedding', treat as embedding for billing. won't require proxy rollback and fixes most cases quickly
maya: good short-term. long-term we should make metering_namespace mandatory in edge events and have an aggregator assertion that rejects events without it in strict mode
chad: we also need console transparency: show a line in invoice preview "X tokens reclassified from text -> embedding during billing fix" with link to ticket. customers will notice cost change otherwise
kevin: operational plan: 1) quick aggregator hotfix that applies heuristic reclassification (canary) 2) proxy patch to restore metering_namespace header with rollout 3) aggregator assertion and stricter ingestion flag 4) backfill script to correct past hour invoices if needed 5) console annotation + alerting
ops-bot: creating ticket MET-4201: "billing: misclassifed embedding events as text due to missing metering_namespace header"
ops-bot: MET-4201 created by erin. priority P1. owner: TBD
lina: propose heuristic: if event.embedding_dim > 0 OR event.embedding_vector_length > 0 OR payload_type == 'embedding' then set effective_kind='embedding' for pricing. keep a debug flag to log reclassifications to a side index for audits
evan: (typo)
kevin: caution: classifier fallback exists for older clients that never set payload_type. heuristic must be conservative to avoid reclassifying short text responses that accidentally set some vector-like field. We'll log every decision and emit metric reclassify_count by tenant
maya: canary: 45min on 30 tenants starting 05:00 UTC. I'll own tenant list and monitors. Alert if reclassify_rate > 0.5% or if invoice_delta > 2% for any tenant in cohort
erin: chad, can you own proxy patch? kevin, you own aggregator hotfix and backfill job
chad: yea I'll put up a small patch to stop dropping metering_namespace and add a feature flag to force it on for the canary cohort
kevin: will add a tombstone field for reclassified events so console can surface why numbers changed. Also will add a backfill CLI to re-evaluate last 2h of events with heuristic and emit correction events to ledger
lina: console UX: show pre/post classification totals and a confidence badge. if backfill applies, show separate correction line item in invoice preview with time and reason
ops-bot: MET-4201 updated: owners assigned: erin (coord), kevin (aggregator + backfill), chad (proxy), maya (canary ops), lina (console). ETA: canary 05:00 UTC tomorrow.
kevin: tests: unit test for heuristic edgecases, integration test simulating missing header + various payloads, and a smoke run on staging to ensure no perf regression
chad: proxy patch will include header passthrough test. minimal risk but we'll monitor tail latency
erin: final note: add a short doc to eng docs about metering_namespace semantics and required fields for billing events. avoids this class of bugs going forward
ops-bot: reminder scheduled: MET-4201 canary kickoff 05:00 UTC tomorrow
